tools.name: search_assets
tools.description:
Search the Spark AI assets marketplace for agents, skills, prompts, prompt chains, MCP connectors and bundles.

Finds assets by text query, for when the slug is not known. Returns a numbered
list of short summaries: title, type, downloads, outcome summary, price, tags and
the asset's URL on spark.en

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description:
Get full details of a Spark asset by its slug — description, metadata, outcome
reports, bundled files and the URL on spark.entire.vc.

Takes a slug, for example from a search result, a popular list or a link. Returns
the full picture of the asset. It does not return the prompt/skill/agent text
itsel

tools.name: get_asset_content
tools.description:
Get the raw content of a Spark asset (prompt text, skill instructions, agent config) —
the actual text to apply, not just a description of it.

Takes a slug. Unlike search_assets and get_asset, this counts as a download/acquisition

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Records the result of applying an asset that was fetched with get_asset_content: applied as is, applied with changes, broke, or not applicable. tools.name: list_popular
tools.description:
List the most popular Spark assets by download count, optionally filtered by type.

Takes no search text; it returns the current top of the catalog by downloads.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description:
List available categories (domains and AI tags) in the Spark marketplace.

Returns the domain slugs that search_assets accepts as its `domain` filter, and the
AI tags, as a taxonomy of the catalog.

Example: list_categories()

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_asset_content" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
